mode_info:
,api:{name:'EstateMaster API option',strip:'EstateMaster API (simulated): the agent reads EstateMaster’s inputs and figures through its API · after a person approves, it writes the change through the API, EstateMaster recalculates and the agent reads the figures back · SQL Server for actuals (demo: simulated)',
  task:'Write the approved changes to EstateMaster (API)',
  how:[['Read','The agent reads every input and output of the model from EstateMaster’s API: no exports to upload. A sync runs on open and after every change.'],
   ['Analyse and propose','The agent answers questions, checks assumptions against market data, Outlook and actuals, designs stress scenarios and drafts reports. Every change it suggests becomes a change request.'],
   ['Approve','A person approves or rejects each change request. Nothing is written to EstateMaster before that. The likely effect is worked out by Claude and OpenAI (cross-checked, marked as AI calc) while it waits.'],
   ['Write through the API','Once approved, the agent writes the values to EstateMaster through the API and asks it to recalculate. EstateMaster does the calculation, as it does today.'],
   ['Read back','The agent reads EstateMaster’s recalculated figures through the API, shows them and logs them against the change request. Every call is in the API log.']],
  can:['Read every input and output through the EstateMaster API, with no exports','Answer questions, compare versions and explain what changed','Check assumptions against market data, zoning, Outlook and actuals','Propose changes as change requests; a person approves each one','Write approved changes through the API and read EstateMaster’s recalculated figures back in seconds','Run stress scenarios in EstateMaster on a sandbox copy through the API','Keep a log of every API call, change, approval and result'],
  cant:['Write anything to EstateMaster before a person approves it','Calculate the official figures: EstateMaster does, through the API','Change the live model outside an approved change request','Use endpoints the EstateMaster API does not offer (in this demo the API is simulated)'],
  prompt:'Deployment: EstateMaster API option. EstateMaster is reached through its API (simulated in this demo). EstateMaster’s figures come from the latest API read (get_status). Tools that change assumptions only raise change requests; once a person approves, the agent writes the change through the API, EstateMaster recalculates and its figures are read back. Never give a figure for a change as if it were a result: say EstateMaster will calculate it once approved.'}
